actual: Lane K pass, Cricmax - Home Location, signed in as Ankit Patel (Admin). An unsaved rename ("QA_AP 514 Expiry 2") sat in the Edit dialog. A save ~44 min after sign-in succeeded ("Success — Plan updated."). At ~65 min the same save failed twice with the generic toast "Error — Couldn't save the plan. Please try again." (dialog stayed open with the input). The expected expiry text never appeared and the app never redirected to sign-in. The Dashboard then showed "Couldn't load today's schedule", "Couldn't load capacity alerts", "Couldn't load coach utilization" and "Couldn't load action items" with "—" tiles; Retry recovered them. At ~66 min the same rename save SUCCEEDED ("Success — Plan updated."). The session did not stay dead and no re-sign-in was needed.
expected: After the session expires, saving shows "Your session expired. Sign in again." and the app goes to the sign-in page.
steps: Sign in as Admin on facility-dev, facility Cricmax - Home Location.
Open a plan's Edit dialog and leave an unsaved rename idle ~65 minutes.
Save. Observe the message (or lack of it) and whether the app redirects.
Save again a minute later and observe.
title: QXR-514 step 5: expired session never shows 'Your session expired' — generic error, then the save succeeds
